result.title: Does a completed simulation run mean a usable urban wind result for AI agents?
result.summary: AI agents based on large language models (LLMs) can now configure and run computational fluid dynamics (CFD) solvers, but a completed run does not ensure that delivered metrics can be recomputed from raw outputs. This gap was examined for urban wind simulation, where multi-case comparisons must hold non-target conditions fixed and reported values must be traceable to raw samples. UrbanWind-AgentBench, comprising 200 tasks and 367 cases in 10 engineering task families, was constructed. Public task contracts specify variable factors, fixed conditions, numerical thresholds and deliverable requirements, and two-layer scoring separates a structural score for deliverables, run provenance and raw evidence from a numerical score obtained by independent recomputation against references. WindPilot was then proposed as an execution framework that incorporates contract parsing, execution provenance, deterministic verification and bounded acceptance review into the LLM execution loop. On 30 OpenFOAM tasks with independent references, at least the structural maximum of 60 points was reached by a base agent on 28 tasks, but numerical credit was obtained on only 6. With the same model name and budget, WindPilot increased the number of tasks with numerical credit to 17, full-score tasks from 0 to 3 and the mean task score from 62.5 to 72.5. Mean action steps fell from 130.4 to 104.9, and mean token consumption decreased by 12.9%. The mean gain for atmospheric boundary layer (ABL) tasks was 18.5 points. A completed simulation run is therefore not sufficient for a usable urban wind result; usability depends on checks that tie reported metrics to raw evidence during execution.

AI.brief_summary: 该文指出 LLM agent 完成 CFD 仿真运行并不等于交付可用结果，构建了含 200 个任务的城市风环境基准（区分结构分与独立重算的数值分），并提出加入契约解析、执行溯源、确定性验证与有限验收的 WindPilot 框架。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「运行完成≠结果可用」的判据与把交付物合规和基于原始证据的独立重算分开打分的思路，可能为 LVR 中「答案是否真正使用视觉/latent 证据」的评测设计与停止决策提供参照，但领域相距较远，需核查可迁移性。
